# phase-053 — Give the REPL a color system: TTY detection, forced modes, and one theme

## You must change `src/`

This phase declares `must_touch: [src/]`. The gate fails the phase unless at
least one changed file falls under it. Writing tests, documentation or a report
is not enough — if you finish without touching that area, the phase fails on
exactly that check.


## Evidence — verified finding

```
The REPL emits no color anywhere: the only ANSI sequence in src/repl/ is the clear-screen `\x1B[2J\x1B[H` at src/repl/mod.rs:209. The prompt (`>>> ` at mod.rs:158), results (`= value` at mod.rs:402), and errors (`Error: {}` at mod.rs:407) are all unstyled plaintext, and there is no module, no `NO_COLOR`/`TERM`/`COLORTERM` handling, and no Windows console setup — so even added colors would misbehave on half the platforms the project ships to (CI pins Windows-green builds). Ipp colors every one of these through a central palette with TTY gating and a `.colors` override; inscript gates every code on `isatty()`. Redblue has neither the palette nor the gate.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Add one central color module (palette + theme struct + TTY/NO_COLOR/TERM gating + Windows ANSI enablement) and apply it to the prompt, results, errors, and the `:help`/`:vars` listings. Add a `:colors` command (on/off/auto) and ship exactly one theme; theme files and switching belong to a later phase.

## Method

1. Read `AGENTS.md` in full. Obey every hard rule; they are not negotiable.
2. Reproduce the finding. Record the exact command and the exact wrong output.
3. Write the failing test FIRST. Watch it fail. Do not touch production code
   until you have a red test that fails for the right reason.
4. Make the smallest change that turns it green.
5. Run the four gates yourself before claiming anything:

   ```bash
   cargo fmt --all -- --check
   cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
   cargo test --all-targets
   ./rbops/verify.sh phase-053
   ```

6. Write `REPORT.md` in the exact shape required by `AGENTS.md` section 4.

## Definition of done

- [ ] with output piped (not a TTY) every byte the REPL prints is identical to before the phase — asserted by a test that captures a session transcript with colors forced off and diffs it against the checked-in expectation
- [ ] `NO_COLOR=1` and `TERM=dumb` each disable all color even on a TTY, pinned by unit tests against the gating function (no TTY required)
- [ ] `:colors off`, `:colors on` and `:colors auto` switch modes inside a live session, and the mode is reported in `:help` output
- [ ] errors print in the error color with the same text as before (color codes around the existing message, never replacing it), so every existing error-text assertion keeps passing unmodified
- [ ] edge_* tests cover an unparsable `TERM`, a Windows build without virtual-terminal processing (degrades to plain, never emits raw escapes into a non-ANSI console), and `:colors` with a bogus argument refused by name
